'''Zan Ransom''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]]. He owned a [[YT-1930 transport/Legends|YT-1930]] [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]], which he named the ''[[Wild Menagerie]]'' and he modified it to improve its performance.
